description: Source code for the TestInfo implementation and related classes in Playwright, handling test steps, attachments, snapshots, and error management.

classes.name: TestInfoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the TestInfo interface, managing test steps, attachments, snapshots, and errors.

classes.name: TestStepInfoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the TestStepInfo interface, representing individual test steps with attach and skip capabilities.

classes.name: TestSkipError
classes.description: Error class used to signal a skipped test.

classes.name: StepSkipError
classes.description: Error class used to signal a skipped step.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Creates and registers a new test step, handling hierarchy and stack trace filtering.

methods.name: _failWithError
methods.description: Marks the test as failed or timed out and records the error.

methods.name: _runAsStep
methods.description: Runs an async callback within a test step context, handling errors.

methods.name: _runWithTimeout
methods.description: Executes a callback with timeout management, handling skips and errors.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a file or data to the test, creating a new attachment step.

methods.name: _attach
methods.description: Internal method to add an attachment and notify via IPC.

methods.name: outputPath
methods.description: Generates a sanitized output path for files related to the test.

methods.name: _getOutputPath
methods.description: Resolves a path within the allowed output directory.

methods.name: _fsSanitizedTestName
methods.description: Returns a sanitized string of the test's full title for filesystem use.

methods.name: _resolveSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Resolves file paths for snapshots, screenshots, and aria snapshots, handling indexing.

methods.name: _applyPathTemplate
methods.description: Applies a path template to generate snapshot or screenshot file paths.

methods.name: snapshotPath
methods.description: Returns the path for a snapshot, screenshot, or aria snapshot based on provided name and options.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for the test.
